content:
Jules H: FYI received INV-5503 from SAPCloud for $24,300. No PO on header, PDF here: https://s3.company/sap/INV-5503.pdf — looks like an overage reconciliation.
Marta C: Quick lookup: we had PO 110450 for SAP Cloud Services but it was marked CLOSED after Q1 billing. Vendor legal name on invoice is 'SAP Cloud Ltd' vs Coupa record 'SAPCLOUD LLC'.
Ken W: Line items show "reserved instance overage" and match our reserved instance SKU. If this ties to PO 110450 we can match; otherwise policy needs reissue.
ProcurementBot: PO 110450 status: CLOSED. Last_receipt: 2025-03-31. Suggested action: request vendor confirmation linking invoice to PO 110450 or reissue with PO on header.
Jules H: Can we accept a vendor confirmation email instead of reissue for speed?
Marta C: For amounts > $10k we prefer vendor reissue, but procurement can accept written confirmation if it includes PO and line-level mapping. I'll reach out to vendor contact now.
invoices-bot: Invoice INV-5503 uploaded to NetSuite (NS-INV-12047). Status: Needs Coding/Approval. Notified: finance-approvers.
Ken W: I'll prepare GL coding (GL 6201 SaaS infra) and draft a memo referencing PO 110450 and vendor email. If vendor confirms in writing, route to L3 for approval.
Jules H: Thanks. Marking as pending vendor confirmation. Please CC finance@redwood on any reissued docs. :thumbsup:
